svg.title: DorkOS systems and deployment boundaries
svg.desc: The client reaches the local execution server. The space server is a second entry and image target of the same server package, with its own Postgres and sign-in. Cloud space management uses a separate public server API contract; rollout is independent of local implementation. Marketplace discovery and installation use the same package sources. Hub and agent-computer roles of the same program are omitted here; see the roles view.
